# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 14 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #fbfbfd);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #1c1925);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fbfbfd;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #fbfbfd | #1c1925 | Raised surfaces: cards, sheets, the composer, the brief panel. |
| `--paper-sunk` | #eceaf2 | #0d0b12 | Wells inside a card: the quote block, the transcript strip, input fields at rest. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #17151f);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #f3f1f8);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #17151f;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #17151f | #f3f1f8 | Primary text and icons on fog, paper and paper-sunk (16:1+ in both themes). Fill of the primary button. |
| `--ink-muted` | #5d5a6b | #a7a3b6 | Secondary text, captions, placeholders on fog and paper (6:1+ light, 7:1+ dark). |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--on-ink, #fbfbfd);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */

/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fbfbfd;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-ink` | #fbfbfd | #121019 | Text on an ink fill (primary button, ink chips). |
| `--on-pulse` | #17151f | #121019 | Text and icons on a pulse fill (5.8:1 light, 7:1 dark). Never white. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--fog, #f3f2f7);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--fog, #121019);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f3f2f7;
```

### Tokens (14)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fog` | #f3f2f7 | #121019 | Page background for both apps. A cool lilac grey, never cream. |
| `--line` | #e2e0ea | #2e2a3a | Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control. |
| `--line-strong` | #8e8a9e | #6e6a80 | Input and control borders (3.2:1 on paper in light, 3.3:1 in dark). |
| `--pulse` | #ff4f8b | #ff6b9e | The Envoi pink. The Echo, the record action, the one moment that matters per view. Graphics and fills only, never text on fog. |
| `--pulse-edge` | #c21e5b | #ff8ab3 | Pink as text or a 1px edge: links, active tab underline, the border on a pulse fill so it clears 3:1 on fog (5.2:1 light, 7.8:1 dark). |
| `--pulse-wash` | #ffe3ec | #3a1b2a | Soft pink ground for a selected option or the recording state. Ink text on it. |
| `--zest` | #d4f55a | #d4f55a | Money and rewards only: the earnings chip, payout receipts, points. Ink text on it. |
| `--zest-deep` | #4a6600 | #d4f55a | Dollar amounts written as text on paper (6.4:1 light, 14:1 dark). |
| `--zest-wash` | #eef9c7 | #2c3312 | Ground for a payout receipt card. Ink text on it. |
| `--tide` | #3a5bff | #8fa2ff | Researcher data: second series in charts, segment tags, links in reports (4.9:1 light, 7.2:1 dark on paper). |
| `--good` | #1e7f4f | #5fd49a | Passed quality checks, filled quotas. Always with a word or check icon. |
| `--warn` | #a85d00 | #f2a93b | Slow fill, expiring soon, needs review. Always with a word or icon. |
| `--critical` | #c2283e | #ff7a8a | Removed responses, payment failed, errors. Always with a word or icon; differs from good in lightness too. |
| `--focus` | #c21e5b | #ff8ab3 | Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (5.2:1 on fog light, 7.8:1 dark). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 64px/60px "Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.045em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.045em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 64px / 60px, letter-spacing -0.045em | 700 | `sans` | One per page at most: marketing heroes, the respondent welcome, the payout moment. |
| `display-l` | `.display-l`, `--text-display-l` | 40px / 42px, letter-spacing -0.035em | 700 | `sans` | The interview question on the respondent screen (32px under 400px wide). |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 30px / 36px, letter-spacing -0.03em | 700 | `sans` | Page titles in the researcher app. |
| `h2` | `.h2`, `--text-h2` | 22px / 28px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 650 | `sans` | Section and theme titles. |
| `stat` | `.stat`, `--text-stat` | 36px / 40px, letter-spacing -0.03em | 700 | `sans` | Counts on the tracking page and the earnings total. Always tabular numbers. |
| `h3` | `.h3`, `--text-h3` | 17px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Card titles and labels for groups of fields. |
| `body-l` | `.body-l`, `--text-body-l` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Respondent body copy and agent messages on mobile. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Default text in both apps. Inputs are 16px so iOS never zooms. |
| `body-s` | `.body-s`, `--text-body-s` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Supporting text, table cells, metadata. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 16px | 600 | `sans` | Chips, tags, button text in dense UI. Sentence case, never all caps. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `sans` | Timestamps and footnotes only. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Manrope", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to label gap, chip inner padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Tight stacks: label to field, chip rows. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Button inner padding, list row gaps. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding on mobile, gutters on mobile. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Between sections inside a page. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Around the Echo, between major page regions. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Page top padding on desktop, hero breathing room. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,21,31,0.06), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(23,21,31,0.22) in the light theme; the table gives its value in the others) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-card), so that a change to tokens.css, or a change of theme, reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-card` | 0 1px 2px rgba(23,21,31,0.06), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(23,21,31,0.22) · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) | Floating cards: the invite card, the brief panel, sheets. Flat cards use a line edge instead. |
| `--shadow-press` | inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 1px 2px rgba(23,21,31,0.2) · dark: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Primary and pulse buttons, so they read as pressable objects next to the 3D Echo. |
